record.prBody:
## claude-sonnet-4-5-20250929 retires on the Claude API Nov 30, 2026; use claude-sonnet-5-5 [Not affected]

### Change

No change made. The repo never names claude-sonnet-4-5-20250929. The Anthropic model defaults to `claude-3-7-sonnet-latest`, set in main.py:21 (via the ANTHROPIC_MODEL env var) and in providers/anthropic_provider.py:10.

No files changed.

### Why

The Nov 30, 2026 retirement applies only to claude-sonnet-4-5-20250929. A search of the whole repo for claude, sonnet and ANTHROPIC found no reference to that ID, so no code change is forced.

> | November 30, 2026 | `claude-sonnet-4-5-20250929` | `claude-sonnet-5-5` |

Source: https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/about-claude/model-deprecations.md

### Proof

No checks were run.

New failures: 0

Provider validators: none run.

Where checks ran: Docker container python:3.12-bookworm; install scripts disabled; no host env or mounts besides the repo copy; no credentials, so no live API calls

### Unproven

- A deployed ANTHROPIC_MODEL env var could still be set to claude-sonnet-4-5-20250929. That would override the default and break on the retirement date; I could not check deployment config.
- claude-3-7-sonnet-latest may be affected by a separate deprecation notice. This task did not cover it and I did not check it.
- No checks were run.

### Behaviour changes

None intended.

---
